children: Canada pharmacy services firm's Q3 revenue rose slightly, slightly beating analyst expectations
Q3 adjusted EBITDA declined and missed analyst expectations
Company onboarded 3,000 new residents after winning national customer contract
CareRx expects new credit agreement to provide greater financial flexibility and reduce cost of capital
Company says pharmacy network is equipped to handle additional scale and support future growth
CareRx to relocate corporate office to Richmond Hill in early 2027
NEW CONTRACT ONBOARDING - Co said onboarding 3,000 new residents from a national customer contract contributed to Q3 results
WARD BEDS CHANGES - Co said ward beds changes in Ontario offset gains from increased beds serviced and cost savings
INCREASED BEDS SERVICED - Co attributed higher revenue to increase in average beds serviced
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 6 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the drug retailers peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for CareRx Corp is C$5.00, about 48.8% above its November 3 closing price of C$3.36
The stock recently traded at 18 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 23 three months ago
